metadata.article_title: Negligent conduct with respect to pulling down, repairing or constructing buildings, etc.

heading.title: Of Offences Affecting the Public Health, Safety, Convenience, Decency and Morals

article.title: Negligent conduct with respect to pulling down, repairing or constructing buildings, etc.
article.content:
290Negligent conduct with respect to pulling down, repairing or constructing buildings, etc.

Section 290 · Chapter XV
Whoever, in pulling down, repairing or constructing any building, knowingly or negligently omits to take such measures with that building as is sufficient to guard against any probable danger to human life from the fall of that building, or of any part thereof, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to five thousand rupees, or with both.
